doctrine_one_line: Falcon sees. Helios aligns. ARES risk-vets. Solo judges. Matt authorises live trade intent. Agent Smith executes authorised broker operations. NEO observes and paper-trades. Ranger manages brackets when enabled. PLUTUS simulates. R2D2 audits, backtests, and guards the blueprint.

organism_analogy.Judgement: Solo + Matt — read alignment + risk + market + own state, decide
organism_analogy.Apprentice: NEO — observer / scorer / paper trader (FTMO_PRACTICE_100K only); promoted by explicit rule, never silently
organism_analogy.Hands: Agent Smith — broker-operation service; executes when explicitly authorised (and only then)
organism_analogy.Trade_management: Ranger — bracket lifecycle module; runs ONLY when enabled by execution authority; not a trader identity
organism_analogy.Simulator: PLUTUS — deterministic broker simulator; replay + training; NEVER production
organism_analogy.Auditor: R2D2 — audit, backtest, blueprint gatekeeper; raises alarms on lane violations
organism_analogy.Builder: HELM — DevOps / infra / ties the team together

command_chain_canonical: 2. HERMES → Falcon (perception layer; emits ProposalContract / DeclineContract → helios_strategy_signals)
3. Falcon fires → Helios V3 daemon (alignment reducer; emits helios:state via DB-canonical pattern)
4. Helios state + ARES gates → trader-gate-compositor (composes proceed flag → trader:gate:composite)
5. trader:gate:composite + Solo's judgement + Matt's intent → trade decision (humans)
6. Trade decision (when authorised) → Agent Smith (broker execution; live IBKR or PLUTUS sim)
7. Open trade → Ranger (bracket lifecycle, when enabled)
8. Trade outcome → outcome_resolver.py (Falcon-side, wick_aware canonical truth)
9. Outcome data → R2D2 (audit, backtest, blueprint feedback)
what_must_never_blur: Eyes never become Hands — Falcon must not execute
Nervous map never becomes Hands — Helios must not execute
Risk reflex never becomes Eyes — ARES must not detect
Apprentice never becomes Live trader — NEO must not trade live
Auditor never becomes any other role — R2D2 must not execute, must not detect, must not align
